meta.title: Hearth — a calmer way to find a housemate
meta.description: Hearth helps students and first-time movers find someone they enjoy living with, with plain-language matches and privacy by default.

auth.body: We will email you a six-digit code. No password needed.

auth.trustBody: One code by email, no passwords, no spam. We never share your email or post anything for you.
auth.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.

home.title: A calmer way to find a housemate.
home.body: We match you on how you live, explain every match in plain words, and never sell your data.

values.label: What matters here
values.compatibilityBody: Rent, area and dates are filters. The real question is whether daily life fits.
values.clarityBody: No mystery score. You see the overlaps and the things worth talking about.
values.privacyBody: We collect the minimum, show approximate areas, and keep safety features free.

night-owl-haven.name: Night Owl Haven
night-owl-haven.description: Your evenings run late and your circle stays small. Home is at its calmest after dark.

quiet-mornings.description: Early to bed, quiet nights and a gentle start to the day. You keep things light and low-key.

calm-sanctuary.description: You keep your circle small and your evenings easy. Home is where you recharge.

steady-rhythm.name: Steady Rhythm
steady-rhythm.description: A bit of company, a bit of quiet. You flex with the week and keep a steady middle.

open-door.name: Open Door
open-door.description: People and plans are part of your week. Your door — and your kitchen — are usually open.
